story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain, read from code and not observed. The empty-wheel airport arrival. The table map closes the limited area. From above, an empty glass-roofed car sits on a creek shelf by a white-water lip with a foam collar. Closer, it lifts off, its shadow sliding out, and is carried well downstream past the oak and the ledge as the current overtakes it. The stranded street car with hazards. The desk record and grid with its stamp. The ground-level slow roll into standing water with 'may' lit. The remedy stamped. The wet-lot tag and April 20 checks. The open curb door beside the remedy card.
